Install google-chrome on Omarchy

The popular web browser by Google (Stable Channel)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add google-chrome
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 156.0.8078.47-1:
    pacman -Qi google-chrome

Open and use google-chrome

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql google-chrome

Frequently asked questions

How do I install google-chrome on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add google-chrome. The download is 199.6 MB and it takes 465.8 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is google-chrome free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed custom:chrome.

How do I uninstall google-chrome?

Run omarchy pkg drop google-chrome. It removes the package from your system.

What does google-chrome depend on?

The package declares 8 dependencies: alsa-lib, gtk3, libcups, libxss, libxtst, nss, ttf-liberation, xdg-utils. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is google-chrome in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as google-chrome (version 156.0.8078.47-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://www.google.com/chrome.
